written_results.statement: For 0<sigma<=1/2, A_N[i,j]=1/(2i+2j+3-2sigma) is an actual positive Gram. With shifted Jacobi alpha=1/2-sigma, Q_N=m^t A_N^-1 m=sum_(n<=N)(4n+3-2sigma)d_n^2.
written_results.scope: Exact finite min-norm interpolation; arithmetic signs retained inside d_n. Same m vector at every damping.

written_results.proof_boundary: No prior L2 membership assumed in the reverse direction. Construct g in L2 from square-summable coefficients; (f_sigma-g)exp(-(3/2-sigma)t)dt is a finite signed measure with zero polynomial moments under y=exp(-2t). Polynomial density identifies the actual source. Written proof, not Lean admission.

written_results.statement: A witness sup_N Q_N(1/3)<=B gives H_(1/3)(T)<=B and Z(R)<=8B+69c. Conversely sup_J Z(2^J)<=C gives Q_N(1/3)<=123(C+123c/2).
